best_match.fbbt_definition: Adult olfactory receptor neuron (ORN) that expresses Or13a (Benton et al., 2025). Its dendrite transduces signals from antennal basiconic sensillum ab6 and it responds to alcohols (Benton et al., 2025). Its axon innervates antennal lobe glomerulus DC2, bilaterally (Benton et al., 2025). It develops from an Nba precursor (Benton et al., 2025). There are approximately 10 of these cells on each side (Benton et al., 2025).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00067016 'adult olfactory receptor neuron Or13a', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
